title: JS native RegExp vs Wasm automata engine duel
description: Reduced conformance and harness slice: native RegExp, project Thompson NFA, and Wasm DFA execution across 20 patterns over a 1 MiB ASCII/BMP corpus. This is not the accepted v2 production workload.

inputs.generation: SplitMix64 seed 0xREGEX2026, 1,048,576 BMP code points, 20 frozen safe regex patterns

oracle.policy: Exact SHA-256 digest over ordered match tuples (pattern_id, start_cp, end_cp, match_len)
oracle.deadCodeDefense: Match tuple digests and code-point search counters are compared across variants.

work.tolerance: Code points, patterns, matches, and captures must match exactly.
